summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.03/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.03 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 14, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 28¢ higher than a week ago, 18¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.19 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.73) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.29).
